display.title: First Far Marker
display.description: Follow the cartographer's first atlas mark to Trail Ruins and return with field notes.

tracker.text: Bring 8 copper ingots for marker plates.
tracker.complete_text: The copper marker plates are ready.

proof.text: Bring a brush and 8 copper ingots back from the survey.

return.text: Return to the cartographer with the brush and copper.

start: The first mark sits {distance} blocks {direction}, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Reach the Trail Ruins and bring a brush with copper for the marker plates.
reminder: Trail Ruins near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring a brush and 8 copper ingots so the atlas can stop guessing.
turn_in: There. The first mark has weight now. A route is different once someone has stood at both ends.
already_completed: The first far marker is already inked.
unavailable: This route needs a steadier apprentice of the map table.
inactive: The marker route is not open right now.
missing_target: The copper helps, but I need you to stand at the ruins before I trust the bearing.
missing_proof: Bring the brush from the fieldwork before we mark the atlas.
locate_failed: The atlas cannot find a Trail Ruins mark from here today.
